close.reason: Heroicons uses 'x-mark' for the close/dismiss X symbol. Direct semantic match.

back.reason: Direct match. Standard left-pointing arrow for back navigation.

next.reason: Direct match. Standard right-pointing arrow for forward navigation.

external-link.reason: Heroicons uses 'arrow-top-right-on-square' for the open-in-new/external link concept. Arrow exiting a square.

more.reason: Heroicons uses 'ellipsis-horizontal' for three horizontal dots. Direct semantic match for more options.

more-options.reason: Heroicons uses 'ellipsis-vertical' for three vertical dots (kebab menu). Direct semantic match.

sidebar.reason: Three horizontal bars with bottom one shorter on the left side. Visually suggests sidebar/panel layout. Best available match in Heroicons.

columns.reason: Heroicons 'view-columns' represents a multi-column layout. Direct semantic match.

anchor.reason: No anchor or jump-to-section icon in Heroicons. 'link' exists but would conflict with the separate 'link' mapping and doesn't convey anchor semantics.

avatar.reason: Heroicons 'user-circle' shows a user inside a circle. Exact match for avatar/profile picture.

users.reason: Heroicons 'user-group' shows multiple people. Direct semantic match for team/group.

add-user.reason: Direct match. Person with a plus sign.

remove-user.reason: Direct match. Person with a minus sign.

assigned.reason: No user-check icon in Heroicons. Using generic 'user' would lose the 'verified/assigned' distinction.

admin.reason: Heroicons 'shield-check' combines a shield with a checkmark. Conveys authority and verification, reasonable for admin.

user-settings.reason: No user-cog or user-gear icon in Heroicons. Using generic 'user' would lose the 'settings' distinction.

anonymous.reason: No incognito, mask, or anonymous user icon in Heroicons.

roles.reason: No roles or permissions-specific icon in Heroicons. 'user-group' is already used for 'users'.

login.reason: Heroicons 'arrow-right-end-on-rectangle' shows an arrow entering a rectangle. Standard login/sign-in metaphor.

logout.reason: Heroicons 'arrow-left-start-on-rectangle' shows an arrow leaving a rectangle. Standard logout/sign-out metaphor.

fingerprint.reason: Direct match (hyphenated as 'finger-print' in Heroicons). Standard biometric icon.

add.reason: Direct match. Universal plus sign for add/create.

edit.reason: Heroicons has both 'pencil' and 'pencil-square'. 'pencil-square' (pencil on a square) is the standard edit icon in UI contexts, matching the edit-in-place concept.

delete.reason: Direct match. Standard trash can icon.

save.reason: Heroicons has no floppy disk or save icon. This is a well-known gap. 'document-arrow-down' is a download icon, not a save icon.

check.reason: Direct match. Simple checkmark for confirm/done/approve.

refresh.reason: Heroicons 'arrow-path' shows circular arrows forming a loop. Standard refresh/reload icon.

undo.reason: Heroicons 'arrow-uturn-left' is a U-turn arrow pointing left. Standard undo metaphor.

redo.reason: Heroicons 'arrow-uturn-right' is a U-turn arrow pointing right. Standard redo metaphor.

copy.reason: Heroicons 'document-duplicate' shows two overlapping documents. Standard copy/duplicate icon.

copied.reason: Heroicons 'clipboard-document-check' shows a clipboard with a checkmark. Exact match for copied/confirmed clipboard action.

paste.reason: Heroicons 'clipboard-document' shows a clipboard with a document. Reasonable match for paste (content on clipboard ready to place).

cut.reason: Direct match. Universal scissors icon for cut.

move.reason: No move/four-directional arrow icon in Heroicons. 'arrows-pointing-out' is expand/fullscreen, not move.

drag-handle.reason: Heroicons 'bars-2' shows two horizontal bars. Commonly used as a drag handle indicator. No grip-dots icon available.

upload.reason: Heroicons 'arrow-up-tray' shows an upward arrow with a tray. Standard upload icon.

download.reason: Heroicons 'arrow-down-tray' shows a downward arrow with a tray. Standard download icon.

import.reason: Heroicons 'arrow-down-on-square' shows a downward arrow onto a square. Reasonable match for importing data.

export.reason: Heroicons 'arrow-up-on-square' shows an upward arrow from a square. Reasonable match for exporting data.

send.reason: Heroicons 'paper-airplane' is the standard send/submit icon. Direct semantic match.

zap.reason: Heroicons 'bolt' is a lightning bolt. Direct semantic match for fast/instant action.

checkbox.reason: No checkbox icon in Heroicons. 'check' is a standalone checkmark without a bounding square.

checkbox-empty.reason: No empty checkbox (square outline) icon in Heroicons.

toggle.reason: No toggle switch icon in Heroicons.

toggle-off.reason: No toggle switch icon in Heroicons.
